question.problem: Which of the following diagrams represents the vector field $F(x,y)=(y-2x)\,i+(2y-4x)\,j$ at the indicated points?
question.worked_solution:
We have to sketch the vector field at the points $(1,3),(-1,-1),$ and $(3,2).$

To sketch the vector field at the given points, we substitute their coordinates into the function $F(x,y)=(y-2x)\,i+(2y-4x)\,j\,:$

$$
\begin{aligned}F(1,3) & =(3-2(1))\,i+(2(3)-4(1))\,j=i+2\,j \\ F(-1,-1) & =(-1-2(-1))\,i+(2(-1)-4(-1))\,j=i+2\,j \\ F(3,2) & =(2-2(3))\,i+(2(2)-4(3))\,j=-4\,i-8\,j\end{aligned}
$$

We now draw our vectors. At each point, we draw the vector associated with that point, placing the tail end of the vector on the point itself. This gives the following diagram.

$$
\begin{aligned}F(-5,3) & =(3-2)\,i+(-5+2)\,j=i-3\,j \\ F(0,0) & =(0-2)\,i+(0+2)\,j=-2\,i+2\,j \\ F(2,-3) & =(-3-2)\,i+(2+2)\,j=-5\,i+4\,j\end{aligned}
$$

We now draw our vectors. At each point, we draw the vector associated with that point, placing the tail end of the vector on the point itself. This gives the following diagram.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14100574/assets/34aca579b2890586365298c764d051f57d4c80977ee975caad505c923343f90d.png)

Which of the following could be the function that generates the vector field above?
question.worked_solution:
We notice the following:

- The horizontal component (i.e., the $i$ component) is positive for *every* vector in our vector field. Therefore, we can rule out the following option:

$$
F(x,y)=-i+x\,j
$$

- As we move away from the origin in the horizontal direction, our vectors' vertical components (i.e., the $j$ components) get longer. Therefore, we can rule out the following options:

$$
G(x,y)=i+2\,j,\,H(x,y)=2\,i-j
$$

Therefore, we conclude that the diagram corresponds to the vector field $K(x,y)=i+x\,j.$

$$

$$

- Moreover, each vector in our vector field is pointing in the *positive* $z$-direction, so the $k$ component of our vector field is positive. Therefore, we can rule out the following option:

$$
H(x,y,z)=-k
$$

$$
F(x,y,z)=\operatorname{ln}⁡x\,k
$$

Therefore, we conclude that the diagram corresponds to the vector field $K(x,y,z)=2\,k.$
